evaluation.overall_comment: The translation captures the full scientific content and structure of the original podcast script, but it exhibits noticeable machine-translation artifacts and syntactic rigidity. While the terminology and information completeness are solid, fluency and readability suffer from unnatural calques, awkward sentence construction, and at least one clear duplication error. Professional linguistic editing is required to align the text with standard Basque syntax, idiomatic flow, and scientific publishing conventions. Currently functional but not yet publication-ready for a native audience.
